input.command:
cd ~/.agents
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
chore(news-watcher): track feeds.md, index.tsv, state.json + summaries/digests

Stop ignoring the feeds config (feeds.md), the tag/URL index (index.tsv),
and the fetch cursor (state.json); commit them alongside the existing
durable outputs summaries/ and digests/ (previously untracked).

index.tsv is a rebuildable derived artifact and state.json is the fetch
cursor — both are now tracked by explicit request, so expect churn on
every fetch/summarize. Noted in .gitignore.
EOF
)"
echo "=== commit summary ==="; git show --stat --oneline HEAD | head -6
echo "=== tail of stat ==="; git show --stat --oneline HEAD | tail -3
echo "=== recap files back to pending, untouched ==="; git status --porcelain skills/discord-me/recap_dm.py skills/discord-me/references/recap-dm.md
input.description: Commit the tracked config + derived artifacts + summaries/digests
